up: Find all molecules that are associated with the document that has ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL2069259'. This document is stored in the 'docs' table. Link the document to the 'compound_records' table via the 'doc_id' column to retrieve the records referenced in this document. Then join the 'molecule_dictionary' table via 'molregno' to get each molecule's details. Optionally, left join the 'compound_structures' table via 'molregno' to include the canonical SMILES (if available). Return exactly one row per distinct molecule with the following columns: the molecule's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), its maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Do not impose any limit on the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs doc JOIN compound_records cr ON doc.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE doc.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2069259';
